note: FACTORY-006 rollback migration: the rollback reads the journal rather than inferring its way back, because a rollback that guesses is a second migration and two migrations do not compose into none. An entry the journal says was never applied is not undone, so a rollback from an interrupted migration does not move a cache that never moved - which is the case that matters, since it is the one where a guess would touch something that was never touched. The source is compared byte for byte after the rollback as it was after the migration, and a rollback whose source has changed is refused. Fault proof: undoing every entry regardless of the journal makes the interrupted-migration assertion fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
